Dhruva Maharaj saw that many serpents with angry eyes were lashing out with fire to swallow them.
To swallow them. Along with that, groups of elephants, lions, and tigers are also coming. The ocean is as vast as the earth, and all the planets are within it.
The sun's heat is like a great flood, as terrible as the end of an era. 27. Shabdartham

Then, for the entire world, a terrible ocean like the time of destruction, with its upthrowing waves and
with a terrible roar, arrived before them. Of various kinds, without fear, without any other.
They are born, they are born, they are born, they are demons. 28>. Shabdartham

Dhue--against Dhue; prayaktam--used; asuraih--by demons; tam--that; mayam--illusory power; ati-dushtaram--extremely;

When the sages heard that Dhruva Maharaj had been defeated by the illusory deeds of the Asuras, they
immediately gathered there for his auspicious wishes.
